summary: 10-Q for Q1 2026 (ended March 31, 2026) shows 327,009,578 Class A and 732,224,903 Class B shares outstanding at quarter-end (1,059,234,481 total), with 330,788,302 Class A as of May 4, 2026; ABTC raised ~$110.5M net via ATM offering in Q1 2026 issuing 84M+ Class A shares; no convertible debt or preferred stock outstanding.

American Bitcoin Corp. effected a 1-for-15 reverse stock split of its Class A common stock, effective July 2, 2026, with trading on a split-adjusted basis beginning July 6, 2026. No BTC holdings, debt, or other capital structure details were disclosed in this filing.

The dominant change from the current model is the 1-for-15 reverse stock split effective July 2 2026: the model's shares_basic of 1,063,013,205 must be divided by 15, yielding ~72.8M split-adjusted shares (SEC 8-K primary source wins over stale pre-split counts). BTC holdings are confirmed at 8,000 as of July 6 2026 per bitcointreasuries.net and the company's own X announcement, superseding the model's May 1 as-of date; bitcointreasuries.net (8,000, July 6) is preferred over CoinGecko (7,500, stale mid-May) because it has an explicit July 6 date matching the company's official disclosure. No straight debt, converts, or preferred stock exist per the Q1 2026 10-Q; the $364.3M Bitmain miner purchase liability is a Bitcoin-collateralized structured obligation, not conventional debt, and is excluded from debt_face to avoid double-counting with the pledged BTC already reflected in total BTC holdings.
